description: This file implements the SAP (SIM Access Profile) service for Android's radio hardware interface, including class definitions, method implementations for handling SAP requests and responses, and service registration logic.

classes.name: SapImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ISap interface handling SAP requests, responses, and callback management.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback interface for SAP responses.

methods.name: connectReq
methods.description: Handles a connect request to the SAP service.

methods.name: transferAtrReq
methods.description: Handles a request to transfer ATR.

methods.name: transferCardReaderStatusReq
methods.description: Handles a request to transfer card reader status.

methods.name: setTransferProtocolReq
methods.description: Handles a request to set transfer protocol.

methods.name: createMsgHeader
methods.description: Creates a message header for SAP requests.

methods.name: addPayloadAndDispatchRequest
methods.description: Adds payload to message and dispatches the request.

methods.name: sendFailedResponse
methods.description: Sends a failure response for a request.

methods.name: checkReturnStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a callback return.
